content: The most recent estimate of the age of the universe, based on observations from the Planck satellite and other data, is approximately **13.8 billion years**. More specifically, the best current estimate is **13.8 billion years, give or take about 20 million years.** This number is constantly being refined as scientists gather more data and improve their models.
